profiles.label: Tech Investors
profiles.purpose: Fast analytical scanning, product credibility, and high-contrast investor storytelling.
profiles.photo_grade: Neutral-to-cool, crisp contrast, restrained saturation, natural skin tones
profiles.chart_behavior: Emphasize one decisive series; use cyan for the selected path and gold for economic proof.
profiles.avoid: All-blue corporate palettes, purple AI gradients, neon overload, and decorative dark dashboards

profiles.label: Educators
profiles.purpose: Human-centered explanation, accessibility, learning outcomes, and approachable evidence.
profiles.photo_grade: Natural warm light, moderate contrast, gentle saturation, authentic classroom and working environments
profiles.chart_behavior: Favor direct labels and accessible comparisons; use teal for learning flow and marigold for emphasis.
profiles.avoid: Childlike classroom motifs, pastel-only palettes, beige monotony, and color-coded meaning without labels

profiles.label: University Leadership
profiles.purpose: Institutional credibility, strategic governance, operational confidence, and executive decision-making.
profiles.photo_grade: Natural institutional light, restrained saturation, composed contrast, realistic materials and skin tones
profiles.chart_behavior: Use gold for institutional priority, teal for systems and expansion, and burgundy only for material risk.
profiles.avoid: Generic collegiate crests, faux heritage styling, navy-only monotony, and ornamental executive decoration

custom_mode.label: Existing Brand / Custom
custom_mode.purpose: Preserve supplied brand identity and derive accessible supporting tokens around locked brand colors.
custom_mode.locked_rule: Never silently replace a supplied brand color. Lock it, define its semantic role, and adapt supporting colors around it.
custom_mode.validation_rule: Apply the same semantic token contract, contrast checks, chart differentiation, photography treatment, and selection persistence used by curated profiles.
